title: Stop Using Clogged Sanding Discs on Drywall — Try Mesh Discs Instead
description:
The difference between a regular sanding disc and a mesh sanding disc is night and day.

Regular discs clog up with drywall dust in minutes, cutting slows down, and you're swapping discs constantly.

Mesh sanding discs? The open weave lets dust flow through to your vacuum, so the disc stays clean, cuts fast, and lasts much longer.

Perfect for:
• Drywall sanding and finishing
• Putty and plaster work
• Corner and edge sanding
• General wall prep for painting

We stock all common sizes and grits.
